Welcome back! We are back on track now with a dedicated maintainer, and very excited for this release. The main thrust of our development work was refactoring the app from Java into Kotlin, and getting the link scanning feature working again.

## Features
- Various improvements to the link scanning feature including better error handling, and more prominent status updates
- Load databases immediately after updating them
- Added Polish translation
## Bug Fixes
- Fixed too many permissions being requested at launch of the app
- Fixed various null pointer exceptions in the link scanning feature
## Development Updates
- Refactored the app from Java to Kotlin
- Updated all dependencies
- Updated various deprecated bits throughout the app
- Cleaned up unused and malformatted strings
- Translation updates
## Database Updates
- Added basic support for domain databases
